title: Reflection Range
objectives: Name the incident ray, reflected ray and normal
Apply the law: angle of incidence = angle of reflection
Predict where a light ray bounces

stages.title: Into the Mirror Maze
stages.narration: Aim true, Ray Master — every angle must be perfect to pass Umbra's maze.

steps.text: Shard 2 glows behind a maze of mirrors.
Umbra: 'Only a master of angles may pass!'
Ray Bot loads a single laser beam.

stages.title: Name That Ray
stages.prompt: For each part of the reflection diagram, choose what it is called.

tasks.label: The ray travelling toward the mirror
tasks.explain: The incoming ray is the incident ray.

tasks.label: The ray bouncing back off the mirror
tasks.explain: After bouncing, it is the reflected ray.

tasks.label: The line drawn at 90° to the mirror
tasks.explain: The normal is at right angles to the mirror; angles are measured from it.

stages.title: Predict the Bounce
stages.prompt: Given the angle of incidence, choose the correct angle of reflection.

tasks.label: Light hits at 30° to the normal
tasks.explain: Angle of reflection = angle of incidence = 30°.

tasks.label: Light hits at 45° to the normal
tasks.explain: i = r, so it reflects at 45°.

tasks.label: Light hits straight along the normal (0°)
tasks.explain: At 0° it reflects straight back along the normal — still i = r.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Aim Through the Maze
stages.prompt: Score 80% to bounce the laser onto shard 2 and claim it!

questions.q: Angle of incidence = 50°. Angle of reflection = ?
Angles of reflection are measured from the…
questions.explain: Always measured from the normal, the 90° helper line.

questions.q: The incident ray, reflected ray and normal all lie…
questions.explain: That is the second law of reflection.

questions.q: The reflected ray is the one that…
questions.explain: The bounced ray is the reflected ray.
At 0° it returns along the same path, since r = i = 0°.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 2 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Ray Master badge
Your laser threaded the maze perfectly!
